d1235.Raw_Article: 1235 Te. kampa, krampa bramble; branch of a thorny tree or plant; (K.) thorn hedge; (K., mod.) kar(r)a kampa id. Nk. kappa id. Ga. (P.) kampa thorny bushes used for fencing. Konḍa kampa id. ? Ka. kompe a small thorn bush, a small bundle or load of thorny twigs. DEDS(N) 160.

d1548.Raw_Article: 1548 Ta. cital, citalai termite, white ant, flying white ant; cel white ant. Ma. cital, citaḷ, cetaḷ termite. Kurub. (LSB 1.12) kadli id. To. kez,al id. (< Ka.). Ka. gedal, gejjalu, geddali, geddalu id. Koḍ. kede white ant. Te. ceda, cedalu white ants, termites. Kol. (Kin.) ceda, (Haig) sēdāl white ant. Nk. śedal id. Konḍa seda white ants. DED(S, N) 1296.
